name: Rohan Mehta
comment: Honestly the best burger I've had in this city. The smash patty technique gives it incredible crust and the comeback sauce is addictive. Will be back every week!

name: Priya Sharma
comment: Perfect burger, perfect fries, perfect experience. The cheese pull alone is worth it.

name: Arjun Patel
comment: Reminded me of the pizzas I had in Naples. The mozzarella di bufala is genuinely fresh and the tomato sauce has incredible depth.

name: Sneha Rao
comment: Crunchiest chicken I've ever had! That buttermilk marinade makes such a difference.

name: Vikram Singh
comment: The paneer tikka masala is restaurant-quality. The charred paneer with that creamy sauce is perfection.

name: Ananya Gupta
comment: The cup-and-char pepperoni concept is genius. Every bite has those amazing crispy pepperoni cups. Only wish there was more cheese.
